parent_evidence.residual_on_note: Paired residual-on reached ~24.15 dB at +72–78 kB R; that arm cannot cross A(q) on this stack.

decision_and_hypothesis: The compact bbox residual-off point is above both saved anchors because auxiliary masks/placement/zip (~27 kB) plus native B+F (~3.3 kB) already exceed A(q), while the predictor sits ~4 dB below VVC QP47. Hypothesis: temporally keyed RLE masks plus delta placement can drop M+H enough that T < 21288, and a still-model-free affine or two-reference predictor can recover ≥0.5 dB toward 24.6 dB without residual. Competing explanations: zip framing, not mask pixels, is the floor; metadata.npy duplicates the mask arrays so RLE of npy files does not change T; the quality gap is the reused plate/B rather than F; union-mask multi-player geometry makes affine warp a no-op versus bbox resize; only residual can buy the missing 4 dB, and residual already costs more than A(q).
question: Can a mask/placement/framing change plus a still-honest residual-off predictor put T below the saved VVC QP47 budget at quality within 0.5 dB of 24.6 dB on this development window?

how_candidate_could_cross_A_q.budget_identity: A(q)-B-M-H is the remaining room for F+R. With B≈4554 B and A(VVC QP47)=21288 B, M+H must fall below ~16700 B before F+R can be non-negative and still under the anchor. Compact aux+zip is currently 26969 B, so about 10 kB must leave the envelope even if F stays 260 B.
how_candidate_could_cross_A_q.rate_path: If keyed XOR/RLE masks plus delta int16 placement plus thinner zip members cut aux+framing from 26969 B to ≤12000 B while reusing stored native B+F (3328 B), T would land near 15 kB, under both 21288 B and 19116 B.
how_candidate_could_cross_A_q.quality_path: Rate under A(q) is not a win at 20.7 dB. Affine-from-first-ref or first+last WebP interpolation must reach ≥24.1 dB (within 0.5 dB of VVC 24.6) without residual. Residual previously bought +3.45 dB for 72 kB and cannot be the first tool on this point.
how_candidate_could_cross_A_q.not_a_win_unless: T below the overlapping neighbour and whole-frame PSNR-Y within 0.5 dB of that neighbour, with reconciled T=B+F+M+R+H and standalone pixels.

evidence_reused.compact_bbox_off_transport: reuse bytes; do not re-encode B or the 260 B first-reference WebP unless a setting explicitly adds a second reference
evidence_reused.gap: Lossless whole-envelope deflate already ran. It does not test a different mask codec, temporal mask keys, placement delta coding, or a stronger residual-off predictor. Do not treat the 217 MB E05 checkpoint as a free F payload.

operating_regime.native_pts_policy: Keep the E03B mapping. Do not relabel extract indices as native frames.

smallest_discriminating_probe.one_changed_axis_rule: Settings 2–4 change only the mask/placement/framing representation against setting 1. Settings 5–6 change only the residual-off predictor against setting 1, holding the current compact mask/header path.

settings.change: Replace 48 uncompressed mask members with per-frame binary RLE; keep predictor and F/B bytes.
settings.expected: T drops if npy/zip storage, not occupancy, dominates; pixels identical.

settings.change: Keyframe mask every 4 frames plus XOR-delta RLE; client reconstructs 48 masks.
settings.expected: Largest plausible M cut if temporal mask redundancy is real.

settings.change: Delta-code bboxes/homographies as int16 and stop shipping a duplicated metadata.npy that recites masks.
settings.expected: Separates header/zip from mask-pixel cost. If T barely moves, zip/metadata was the floor.

settings.change: Same single first-reference WebP; place with a 2D affine estimated from mask moments/bbox, not bbox resize. Still not optical flow or pose.
settings.expected: PSNR-Y +≥0.5 dB vs control if resize-into-union-bbox is the quality leak.

settings.change: Charge a second last-occupied-frame crop (same WebP recipe as F) and linearly interpolate placement between first and last. Residual off. Not a neural predictor.
settings.expected: Tests whether one extra F payload can buy the missing 4 dB cheaper than residual.

controls: Reuse prepared RGB and panorama-QP47 hashes before any pack.
Residual-off and R=0 on every setting; do not reopen the 72 kB residual arm.
Lossless floor arms: standalone pixels equal the control decode.
Predictor arms: ordinary vs standalone pixels equal; quote whole-frame PSNR/SSIM/VMAF beside identical 97.93 / unrelated 1.38 / severe-blur 0.0 VMAF.
Ledger T=B+F+M+R+H on the compact file length; native payloads stored as-is; do not manufacture H as T minus logical arrays.
Unrelated reconstruction must not outrank the decode.
Client timing n_repeats≥2 with repeat_seconds; missing speed does not drop a valid RD row.
No confirmation sources, no BD-rate, no conventional/background re-encodes, no training.
competing_explanations: Zip framing (~5 kB) plus duplicated metadata.npy, not mask occupancy, is the remaining floor.
Union masks cover two players; affine-from-one-crop cannot match per-player geometry.
Background plate error, not F, sets the 20.7 dB ceiling.
Only block residual can reach ~24.1 dB, and its byte cost already exceeds A(q).
Keyframe-every-4 masks change pixels (not lossless) and fail the floor parity control.

T_bytes.basis: Cannot exceed current compact control; tool floor above empty zip.

psnr_y_db.basis: Control 20.7 dB; do not expect AV1 27.4 from warp alone; below 18 is a decode/composite alarm.

client_s.basis: Saved compact client 0.34–0.56 s n=3 on gpu5.

budget.estimated_from_prior: Compact client 0.34–0.56 s × 3 repeats × 6 settings plus RLE/XOR CPU and at most one extra 360p WebP crop. Implementation of RLE/XOR/affine is a separate bounded coding task, not hidden inside this 15 min run cap.
budget.control_budget_share: At least one third for reuse hashes, pixel parity, ledger, calibration inheritance, timing repeats.
budget.if_exceeded: Stop after the floor trio (settings 1–4) and do not start predictor encodes.

decision_rule.stop: Best lossless floor T still ≥ 21288 B, or predictor arms gain <0.5 dB PSNR-Y versus control, or a floor arm changes pixels, or residual is reintroduced, or hashes miss.
decision_rule.promote: At least one setting has T < 21288 B and PSNR-Y within 0.5 dB of VVC QP47 24.6 dB (or T < 19116 B within 0.5 dB of AV1 QP63 27.4 dB), ledger reconciles, and client repeats are genuine. Then cost a single residual QP on that floor/predictor only.
decision_rule.inconclusive: T falls under A(q) but quality stays ~20.7 dB, or quality rises without a T cut: report both axes, do not claim a codec win, do not BD-rate.
do_not: train or attach the 217 MB checkpoint
treat whole-envelope deflate as this probe
upgrade n_repeats=1 or inf PSNR into a claim

artifact_and_narrative.supported_sentence: On this development window, keyed/RLE masks and a still-model-free warp put compact T below the saved VVC QP47 budget at matched quality without residual.
artifact_and_narrative.contradicted_sentence: After charging a thinner M+H and a stronger residual-off predictor, either T stayed above A(q) or quality stayed ~4 dB short, so this configuration still cannot win at comparable quality.
artifact_and_narrative.scope: One 4 s development scene at 360p/12 fps. Not a Gate A/B pass.
